title: Builder project registration - what buyers should verify before booking
p1:
A builder's fancy brochure can hide the one detail that decides whether your dream home is a safe investment or a future headache.

Before paying a booking amount, many buyers check the location, price, and amenities. But they often miss the project registration details.
p2: A common misconception is that a project being advertised online or having a big builder name automatically means everything is verified. The surprising part? Registration details can reveal approvals, project status, and important information buyers should know before committing money.
p3:
Before booking, verify the project's registration number, approved plans, promised delivery timeline, and whether the details match official records. A small verification today can prevent major problems later.

Smart buyers don't just buy a home; they verify the foundation behind the promise.
conclusion: Have you ever checked a builder project's registration details before booking, or did you rely only on the builder's reputation? What will you verify first for your next property purchase?
